Con si, el servidor lleva la cuenta del: With si, the server keeps track of each player's money and does not accept what it cannot justify.
Con si, el servidor mira si el mundo que: With si, the server checks whether the world the incoming player's game brings is its own, that of another real version, or one changed with mods, and acts according to the following options. Con si, en hospitales, comisarías, casas: With si, nobody can hurt anybody in hospitals, police stations, houses and inside venues.

Con si, los jugadores tienen un canal pa: With si, players have a channel to talk in character, heard only by those nearby, another to talk out of character, heard by the whole server, a command to describe what their character does and a profile line others can read. Con si, quien firma un contrato fijo en: With si, whoever signs a permanent contract at the job center gets their paycheck at the end of each period. Cuántos turnos de un contrato fijo cuent: How many shifts of a permanent contract the server counts for a player on the same game day.
